minVersion.description: Lowest protocol version accepted by the gateway.

maxVersion.description: Highest protocol version accepted by the gateway.

nonce.description: Single-handshake challenge value to return unchanged when authenticating.

SessionChallenge.description: Server challenge received before authentication. The SDK checks version overlap, then returns the nonce with credential evidence; callers normally use NessaClient.connect instead of building this payload.

id.description: Identifier of the connecting client application or instance.

ProductClientMetadata.description: Caller identification sent during the product handshake. This metadata does not grant permissions.

minVersion.description: Lowest protocol version supported by this client.

maxVersion.description: Highest protocol version supported by this client.

nonce.description: Nonce from the current SessionChallenge; a reconnect obtains a new one.

credential.description: Opaque secret credential evidence. Send only during authentication; do not log it.

client.description: Descriptive client metadata, separate from authenticated identity.

SessionAuthenticateParams.description: Wire request for session.authenticate. NessaClient.connect builds this after validating the server challenge; a successful response is ProductSessionReady.

principalId.description: Authenticated human, integration, or agent identity.

organizationId.description: Organization in which this session operates.

membershipId.description: Membership connecting the principal to this organization.

credentialId.description: Credential used to authenticate this connection.

audienceId.description: Gateway audience to which the credential is bound.

expiresAt.description: Exclusive Unix seconds, or null for no expiry.

grants.description: Current credential restrictions; not permanent authorization.

methods.description: Registered product methods; permission is checked for every command.

ProductSessionReady.description: Authenticated connection snapshot returned by the product handshake and auth.session(). Links the principal, organization membership, credential, and gateway. It describes current restrictions; the server checks current authorization again for every command.

kind.description: Category of actor; this alone does not grant access.

ProductPrincipal.description: Identity that acts in the product: a human, integration, or agent. A principal needs an active organization membership and an appropriate credential to access the gateway.

role.description: Organization role evaluated by authorization policy.

state.description: Whether the membership is active or disabled.

ProductMembership.description: Relationship between a principal and an organization. The role participates in authorization and disabled membership prevents access.

organizationId.description: Organization owning the resource; must match the credential organization.

id.description: Resource identifier, such as the gateway ID for server operations.

ProductResource.description: Organization-scoped authorization target used by ProductGrant. The gateway resolves the actual resource for each operation before checking policy.

action.description: Authorization action, for example server.read. This is a policy action rather than an RPC method name such as server.health.

resource.description: Exact organization-scoped target on which this action is requested.

ProductGrant.description:
One action/resource restriction on a credential. Used in credential issuance, credential metadata, and authenticated session snapshots. A grant is not a standalone permission: current membership and server policy must also allow the operation.

For example, { action: "server.read", resource: { organizationId: "personal", id: "gateway" } } scopes server-read access to that gateway; use the actual organization and gateway identifiers from your installation.

id.description: Identifier used to revoke this credential.

organizationId.description: Organization in which the credential applies.

audienceId.description: Gateway audience allowed to accept this credential.

expiresAt.description: Exclusive Unix seconds, or null for no expiry.

revokedAt.description: Revocation time in Unix seconds, or null if not revoked.

grants.description: Action/resource restrictions evaluated along with current server policy.

ProductCredentialMetadata.description: Non-secret description of a credential returned by issue and list operations. Describes who it authenticates, its gateway audience, lifetime, and grant restrictions; it cannot itself authenticate a connection.

requestId.description: Idempotency key identifying this issuance operation.

principal.description: Identity the new credential will authenticate.

membership.description: Organization membership associated with that principal.

expiresAt.description: Exclusive Unix seconds, or null for no expiry.

grants.description: Requested action/resource restrictions; at least one is required.

CredentialIssueParams.description: Wire input for issuing a scoped credential. Prefer client.credentials.issue, whose IssueCredentialParams allows the SDK to generate requestId. Reuse the same ID and inputs when explicitly retrying an uncertain result.

CredentialListParams.description: Empty wire input for credential.list. The SDK list() method supplies this object.

requestId.description: Idempotency key to reuse for retries of this revocation.

credentialId.description: Identifier of the credential to revoke.

CredentialRevokeParams.description: Wire input for credential.revoke. Prefer client.credentials.revoke to generate and preserve the request ID.

credential.description: Non-secret metadata for the issued credential.

secret.description: One-time credential evidence accepted by product connect auth. It is not replayed on a duplicate request.

IssuedCredentialResult.description: First successful issuance response. Contains secret evidence only once; keep it in private storage before discarding the result.

credential.description: Metadata for the previously issued credential.

secretUnavailable.description: Always true: this response does not contain a usable secret.

ExistingCredentialResult.description: Response when the issuance request ID already completed. Metadata is returned, but the original secret cannot be recovered by retrying.

credentials.description: Non-secret credential records returned by the gateway.

CredentialListResult.description: Credentials visible to the authorized caller, without secret evidence.

revision.description: Authorization-state revision returned by the mutation.

SessionCloseReason.description: Product session termination reasons used to determine whether connection recovery is allowed. Revocation, expiry, authorization loss, and incompatible protocols are terminal; transient transport and gateway failures may retry.

PrincipalKind.description: Supported categories of authenticated actors: human users, integrations, and agents.

MembershipRole.description: Organization roles understood by product authorization policy.

MembershipState.description: Membership availability. Disabled membership prevents access even when credential evidence is valid.

code.description: Product reason corresponding to the WebSocket close code.

retryable.description: Whether the reason permits connection recovery; cannot override numeric-code policy.

retryAfterMs.description: Optional server delay hint in milliseconds, bounded to 60,000.

SessionTermination.description: Structured WebSocket close reason. The SDK derives retry policy from the numeric close code and accepts matching, bounded server delay hints.
